The analytic q series yields the long-time law; checker.py verifies 92 independent finite diagnostics but is not proof.

value.rationale: Direct KL is an information-geometric/probabilistic calibration of two natural circle semigroups. The exact global uniqueness theorem for every diffusion time and finite limiting information loss make the sharp failure of first-moment matching (diverging KL) mathematically substantive and useful for wrapped-distribution approximation; not a renaming of squared L2 calibration.
